summary: The root لوم (lwm) primarily means to blame, censure, or reprehend someone for something. It signifies finding fault or expressing disapproval.
lane: 1 لَامَ ذ , inf. n. لَوْمٌ , He blamed, censured, or reprehended, syn. عَذَلَ , (S, M, Msb, K,) a person, (S, Msb,) عَلَى كَذَا [for such a thing]. (S.)

headwords.def: inf. n. لَوْمٌ, He blamed, censured, or reprehended, syn. عَ َلَ, (S, M, Msb, K,) a person, (S, Msb,) عَلَى كَ َا [for such a thing]. (S.)
He did a thing for which he should be blamed. (S in art. جنف, and L and TA in art. ريب.)
A thing for which the doer is blamed. (TA.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
